name: RicingScreenshots
description:
Draw on screenshots and record your screen with sound — all in a few clicks.

• Print or Shift+Super+S: drag over an area and it is copied to the clipboard at once. Then draw on it, add arrows and boxes, highlight or crop it, and copy again.
• Super+V: pick an area, press Rec, and it records with the system sound (no microphone). Stop from the button by the area, the top bar or Super+V again, then save it to Videos or anywhere else, with or without the sound.

While it is on, it borrows GNOME's Print key and Super+V (the notification list stays on Super+M); GNOME's own settings are not changed. From the maker of RicingDock.

Clipboard access: the extension only writes the screenshots you take to the clipboard. It never reads the clipboard.
